top: In 1996, a stray cat in Brooklyn ran back into a burning garage. Not once. Five times.
comment: Each time, Scarlett came out carrying one of her kittens. Her eyes were blistered shut and her paws burned, but all five made it out.
topic_it: La gatta Scarlett (Brooklyn, 30 marzo 1996) rientra 5 volte nel garage in fiamme per salvare i 5 gattini; adottata da Karen Wellen, morta nel 2008
photo_it: Scarlett con i suoi gattini dopo l'incendio (via Bored Panda)
sound: it's like i'm not even here — mthu
title: She walked through fire to save her babies #storytime #cats #emotional
description:
In 1996, a stray Brooklyn cat named Scarlett ran into a burning garage five times to carry out her kittens, one by one.
